# `dotnet_diagnostic.ide0055.severity`

Set this to none to opt a file out of formatting.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `none` | Curb leaves the file as written. `dotnet format whitespace` still formats it. |
| `silent` | Formats the file, the same as `warning`. |
| `suggestion` | Formats the file, the same as `warning`. |
| `warning` |  |
| `error` | Formats the file, the same as `warning`. |

**Default:** `warning`

## Conformance

No known case where Curb's output is not a fixed point of `dotnet format` — see [conformance](../../design-principles/conformance.md).

### `dotnet_diagnostic.ide0055.severity = none`

```ini
dotnet_diagnostic.ide0055.severity = none
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Value { get; set; }

    public int Double( )
    {
        return Value*2;
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Value { get; set; }

    public int Double( )
    {
        return Value*2;
    }
}
```
:::

::::
